tested the best and worst drywall anchors, and these are my top 3 recommendations for hanging pictures, shelves, and heavy objects on drywall: Toggler plastic toggle bolt anchors, standard wall plugs, and Stud Solver self-drilling anchors. I'll show you how to install each drywall anchor correctly, how much weight they can hold, and which one to use for your next DIY project.
